title: Djoser depicted in the Saqqara Step Pyramid labyrinths, while later pyramids have no interior decoration

tellings.quote: the sakara step pyramid down in those labyrinths below that there are depictions of the pharaoh joer up on the wall in his iconic like striding forward in a he said festival.

plain: Deep in the tunnels under the Step Pyramid at Saqqara in Egypt, there are carvings on the walls of the early pharaoh Djoser, shown in his famous striding pose during the Heb Sed, a royal festival of renewal. A researcher named Luke Caverns describes this without naming a source. He sets it against the later pyramids, which he says have no decoration inside at all, a contrast that would mean those later pyramids may not have been built the way we usually assume.
